_README: School of Engineering school-level requirements, 2026-2027 catalog, composed with every SoE program (Prompt 08 B1).

Gen-ed at SoE is not a Core: the catalog's programs of study carry Humanities/Social Sciences (H/SS) electives, and SOC certifies approved H/SS courses per term with the code SOEHS ('SOE: Approved Humanities/Social Science'). This component holds the TWO H/SS electives of the first-year program common to all four-year curricula; each major's curriculum adds its own H/SS slots (encoded with the major).
There is no school-wide degree total: 'varies from 120 to 132 credits ... depending on the major' - each major states its own (program_version.degree_credits).
The SoE curriculum page with the H/SS distribution rules (courses, credits, levels) returned HTTP 403 to a plain GET: those rules are unknown here, not assumed.
